```powershell
Write-Output '=== JOB 544 - HUNT THE REAL LINK CALL AND LINK THE LEVELS (Ground: job 542 redesigned the world and saved it, but its link check printed the add call missing on the world object, so the levels still stand unlinked. This job sweeps the editor modules for a streaming level add call, tries each one it finds against the OMNIWorld and VEILWorld maps, and saves only if a link call lands. The job also greps the engine headers for the same call names, so the next step reads the engine itself if Python holds nothing. No game relaunch rides this job. Every variable carries the p544 prefix.) ==='
$p544b64 = ''
$p544py = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\world544.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p544py, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p544b64))
$p544cmd = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$p544proc = Start-Process -FilePath $p544cmd -ArgumentList @('"D:\VEIL-OMNI\VEIL.uproject"', '-run=pythonscript', ('-script="' + $p544py + '"'), '-unattended', '-nopause', '-nosplash') -PassThru
Write-Output ('WORLD LAUNCHED pid=' + $p544proc.Id)
$p544poll = 0
while (-not $p544proc.HasExited -and $p544poll -lt 19) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $p544poll = $p544poll + 1 }
Write-Output ('CMD POLLS=' + $p544poll + ' exited=' + $p544proc.HasExited)
$p544page = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\world544.txt'
if (Test-Path $p544page) { Get-Content $p544page | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('PAGE ' + $_) } } else { Write-Output 'PAGE STILL MISSING' }
if (-not $p544proc.HasExited) { Write-Output 'CMD STILL RUNNING - PAGE RIDES THE NEXT READ' }
$p544h1 = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Source\Editor\UnrealEd\Public\EditorLevelUtils.h'
if (Test-Path $p544h1) { @(Select-String -Path $p544h1 -Pattern 'AddLevelToWorld|AddStreamingLevel|CreateStreamingLevel' | Select-Object -First 5) | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('HEADER ' + $_.Line) } } else { Write-Output 'HEADER MISSING EditorLevelUtils' }
$p544h2 = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Source\Runtime\Engine\Classes\Engine\World.h'
if (Test-Path $p544h2) { @(Select-String -Path $p544h2 -Pattern 'AddLevelToWorld|AddStreamingLevel|CreateStreamingLevel' | Select-Object -First 5) | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('HEADER ' + $_.Line) } } else { Write-Output 'HEADER MISSING World' }
Write-Output 'PHI P544 VERDICT: LINK PAGE PRINTED ABOVE'
Write-Output 'JOB 544 DONE'
```
